notes: Dev ABox revision whose edited relation carries functionality (has_gender: one gender per noun). 'Buch' is neuter for no formal reason (unlike '-chen' nouns such as 'Mädchen', which would leave a route back through the suffix rule), so the edit has no premise route. Related near: functional ('Is Buch neuter?' becomes no). Related far: inheritance of the stored article rule for feminine nouns; 'das Buch' is stated everywhere, so the answer is stored and must change to 'die'. Derived: a role chain through a rare compound with 'Buch' as head (has_head ∘ has_gender ⊑ has_gender, already in RELATIONS.md), a binding that reaches 'Buch' through its plural 'Bücher' (a separate word form the model holds; revised after review, since vocabulary lists print 'book' together with 'das Buch', which made the earlier translation binding close to stored), and an application: the form of the adjective 'dünn' in 'a thin book' (one rule: after an indefinite article, an adjective before a feminine noun ends in '-e'; asking only the adjective avoids a whole German phrase with several fair translations such as 'schmal'). Unrelated near asks 'Kind', a very common neuter noun (revised from 'Heft', which smaller models may not know). 'Buch' and its compounds are not used in the main split (which uses Haus, Autotür, Küchentisch). Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
